author: New Mexico Sun
title: University of New Mexico partners with Altitude Sports to televise four football games
text:
The University of New Mexico has announced a new partnership with Altitude Sports to broadcast four home football games during the 2025 season. This agreement will extend coverage across nine states, increasing exposure for Lobo Football and the university.
The scheduled broadcasts on Altitude include games against Idaho State on September 6, New Mexico State on September 27—known as the Rio Grande Rivalry—Utah State on October 25, and Colorado State on November 15. With this deal, 11 out of the team’s 12 games will be available through linear television.
Fernando Lovo, Vice President/Director of Athletics at UNM, commented on the partnership: “Partnering with Altitude Sports & Entertainment, home of the Denver Nuggets and Colorado Avalanche, gives Lobo Football unprecedented exposure across the West. Getting our product out there is critical—to recruiting, to building our fan base, and to raising the profile of UNM Athletics. It is a big win for the program.”
Lovo also acknowledged Sr. Associate A.D. Kasey Byers and Playfly Sports General Manager Brent Moore for their roles in finalizing the arrangement.
Matt Krol, Senior Vice President/General Manager of Altitude Sports & Entertainment, stated: “Altitude Sports is proud to bring the excitement of Lobo football to fans across the region. Through Altitude TV and our streaming platform, Altitude+, we’re making it easier than ever for fans to connect with the team they love and experience every big play all season long.”
The broadcast team will feature Robert Portnoy and Don Trell Moore. Portnoy serves as Voice of the Lobos while Moore is recognized as one of the most decorated players in program history.
Altitude Sports can be accessed via DIRECTV, DIRECTV Stream, Spectrum TV, FuboTV, and other regional providers in Colorado, Arizona, Idaho, Kansas, Montana, Nebraska, New Mexico, South Dakota, and Wyoming. More information about viewing options is available at www.altitudesports.com/how-to-watch.
Additionally, all four games will stream for free through the Mountain West Network on platforms such as GoLobos.com and TheMW.com as well as through mobile apps compatible with iOS and Android devices along with AppleTV, Roku, Amazon Fire Stick, and AndroidTV.
Altitude Sports & Entertainment launched in September 2004 and has become a leading regional sports network in the Rocky Mountains region. The network was established by Stan Kroenke—owner of several professional teams including the Denver Nuggets—to provide comprehensive sports coverage throughout the area.
